_comment: Undyed cotton canvas (duck) (Phase08 8.4, RD-P08-5): a heavy plain weave, the stuff of sneakers, tote bags and work jackets. Authored at the unbleached cotton's own pale ecru so a Creator's tint (a 0-1 multiply) reaches the khakis, olives, navies and black below it. OPAQUE with a little FUZZ: matte, with fewer loose fibres than a knit. The weave (16 ends x 14 picks per cm) is the article's own normal and roughness.
name: Canvas_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Colour: unbleached cotton duck's pale ecru (linear 0.66, 0.60, 0.48; no measured value; Physically Based has no fabric entries), a little darker and warmer than Cotton_Jersey's bleached yarn. IOR 1.53: cellulose. Roughness ~0.86 in the map: matte. Fuzz 0.35: a tightly woven, plied yarn sheds less than a knit (Cotton_Jersey 0.6), more than denim (0.3).
